_comment: Extracted from the source spreadsheet 'Template PDP DeWalt' (SBD_Brand_Commerce_Playbook_Outputs.xlsx, sheet 'Template PDP'). This is the standard asset list every generated SKU page should cover. Format/instruction text is verbatim or lightly paraphrased from that sheet; assets 9-14 had no instruction/format filled in the source sheet (noted below) and were extrapolated in the first generation (DWST60436) -- keep doing that consistently, and flag the extrapolation in the row's `flag` field like DWST60436 did.

core_assets.name: Hero Shot
core_assets.instruction: Imagem solo do produto em fundo branco, na melhor posicao possivel.
core_assets.notes: No headline/bars/text -- marketplace hero-shot convention. single=True (base image IS the final asset).

core_assets.name: Conteudo da caixa ou do kit
core_assets.instruction: Detalhar os SKUs filhos em caso de kit, ou em caso de produto sem bateria informar.
core_assets.notes: If the SKU is a kit/bundle of sub-parts, label each with its own SKU + short description. If it's a single non-kit product, show what's in the box instead (accessories, batteries or lack thereof, etc).

core_assets.name: Diferenciais tecnicos
core_assets.instruction: Infografico mostrando os detalhes e diferenciais tecnicos do SKU.
core_assets.notes: 4ish callouts (chip_list), the single most differentiating real mechanism/feature as the headline.

core_assets.name: Familia
core_assets.instruction: Logo oficial da familia que o SKU faz parte.
core_assets.notes: Use the official family/line lockup graphic verbatim if you can find one on the brand's own site -- do not fabricate a logo. single=True. If no official family graphic exists for this line, say so and skip or substitute with plain text lockup, flagged.

core_assets.name: Diferencial tecnico
core_assets.instruction: Imagem aplicada ou comparativa com outro produto informando em destaque o principal valor entregue pelo item (valor entregue - o que entregamos).
core_assets.notes: One single, evidence-backed value prop (e.g. a real certification/rating), shown with a real photo, not a studio still, when possible.

core_assets.name: Comparativo tecnico
core_assets.instruction: Comparacao com competidores sem dizer o nome por cores de identificacao -- definir o quesito que vamos comparar.
core_assets.notes: NEVER fabricate a competitor's number. Pick a defensible, verifiable quesito for the DEWALT side; leave the competitor value as a clearly marked pending placeholder (pending_ribbon + 'dado a confirmar') unless real competitor data was actually found and verified in this run.

core_assets.name: Comparativo diferenciadores
core_assets.instruction: Comparativo com modelos similares DeWalt (mostra diferencas relevantes para o usuario).
core_assets.notes: Internal-only comparison (this SKU vs. a close sibling/alternative in the same brand line) using only verifiable facts -- no external data dependency, should always ship 'ready' (no pending flag).

core_assets.name: Aplicacao
core_assets.instruction: Imagem focada em uma aplicacao ou linha de produto (ex.: aplicacao para obras, linha premium, uma profissao).
core_assets.notes: Real lifestyle/application photo, not a studio still.

core_assets.name: Linha de Produtos compativeis
core_assets.format: 2000x2000 - JPG (assumed -- not filled in source sheet)
core_assets.instruction: Not specified in the source sheet -- infer from the product's own compatibility/retrocompatibility claims on its official spec page.
core_assets.notes: No photo needed -- plain informational black-field asset is fine, matching DWST60436.

core_assets.name: Aplicacao
core_assets.format: Not specified in source sheet (use 2000x2000 for consistency)
core_assets.instruction: Uso real da aplicacao com bullets tecnicos ou diferenciais.
core_assets.notes: Second application shot, this one WITH bullet chips overlaid (unlike asset 8).

enriched_pages.name: Pagina enriquecida 1
enriched_pages.notes: Not specified in source sheet. DWST60436 pattern: reuse the Hero Shot photo + a 3-bullet recap of the top value props. Wide module, 2000x1047 (1200:628 ratio).

enriched_pages.name: Pagina enriquecida 2
enriched_pages.notes: Reuse the Application photo (asset 8) + use-case bullets.

enriched_pages.name: Pagina enriquecida 3
enriched_pages.notes: Reuse the Diferenciais tecnicos photo (asset 3) + expanded technical bullets.

enriched_pages.name: Pagina enriquecida 4
enriched_pages.notes: Reuse the Familia asset (asset 4) + warranty/compatibility bullets.

fonts.headline: Archivo Expanded Black (uppercase, two-tone: first line white, second/emphasis line yellow)

brand_system_rules.layout: Yellow bars top+bottom frame every tile; headline sits bottom-left or top-left inside the black/photo field between the bars; see tile_kit.py for exact component functions.
brand_system_rules.source: DW_Global-Brand-Equity-ToolKit-EN-v2_DBG1.pdf (DEWALT global brand toolkit) -- already extracted into tile_kit.py's BASE_CSS, do not need to re-read the original PDF.
